Maya (People Ops): @here Heads-up: All-hands next Tue 9:00 AM PT. Short agenda below + Q collection link: https://forms.gle/redwood-ah-ask
Andre Vogel (CEO): I'll share a brief company health update and a note on hiring priorities (3 min).
Nina Cho (Product Marketing): Ill present the new Dedicated launch messaging and the timeline for customer comms (5 min).
Ezra K. (Eng): I'll give a 6-min engineering update: rollout progress, perf numbers, and a short incident recap from last week.
Sam (Support): I'll summarize top support themes and planned FAQs. Will post examples beforehand.
Maya (People Ops): Format: 30 min. 10 min exec/product, 8 min eng, 5 min support, 7 min live Q&A. Recording + transcript posted after.
Nina Cho (Product Marketing): Deck (draft) uploaded here: https://redwood.share/drive/dedicated-launch-v1. Feedback welcome.
Ezra K. (Eng): Incident note: recent spike caused by stale cache entries; mitigated with a rolling purge and an alert to detect recurrence.
Maya (People Ops): Please add 1-2 Qs in the form by Mon 3 PM so we can triage live Qs. If you need captioning, DM me.
ops-bot: :bell: Reminder set  All-hands Tue 9:00 AM PT. Calendar invite updated.

Maya (People Ops): TAKEAWAYS: 1) Dedicated launch date tentatively set for May 15. 2) SLA target for pilot: 99.95% for critical APIs. 3) Incident mitigation: cache purge automation and new alerting. 4) Support will publish billing + surge FAQs next week.
Andre Vogel (CEO): Thanks for concise updates. Expect follow-up emails with owners and deadlines.
Nina Cho (Product Marketing): Going to finalize external comms next week; please tag me on any customer stories.
Sam (Support): Posting FAQ draft in #support-desk for review.
Maya (People Ops): Action list with owners posted into the follow-up doc; will copy into #all-hands. :white_check_mark:
